title: Project Manager - Branding
description:
**Project Manager \- Branding** 




 About Us
 



 At Springboard Digital, we help brands stand out through strategy, design, storytelling, and digital experiences.
 



 We're looking for a
 **Project Manager** 
 who can bring structure to creativity, manage multiple projects, coordinate teams, and ensure projects are delivered smoothly, on time, and within scope.
 



  





 What You'll Be Doing in Project Management
 


* Manage projects from kickoff to final delivery.
* Create timelines, milestones, deliverables, and project plans.
* Track progress, deadlines, dependencies, and approvals.
* Identify risks and resolve bottlenecks proactively.
* Manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively.



 Client \& Team Coordination
 


* Act as the primary point of coordination between clients, internal teams, vendors, and leadership.
* Understand client requirements and communicate them clearly to the team.
* Manage client expectations, feedback, timelines, and deliverables.
* Coordinate Designers, Writers, Developers, Marketers, and Client Servicing teams.
* Conduct project meetings and maintain MoMs.



 Resource \& Process Management
 


* Coordinate resource allocation and team bandwidth.
* Ensure clear ownership of tasks and responsibilities.
* Maintain project trackers, reports, and documentation.
* Keep project management tools updated.
* Follow and improve agency workflows and SOPs.



 Scope of Work
 



 The Project Manager may handle:
 


* **Branding:** 
 Brand Identity, Packaging, Brand Refresh
* **Marketing:** 
 Social Media, Campaigns, Product Launches, Performance Marketing
* **Digital:** 
 Websites, Landing Pages, UX/UI
* **Internal:** 
 Process Improvements and Strategic Initiatives



 What We're Looking For
 


* 1–3 years of experience in Project Management, preferably in a
 **creative, branding, marketing, or digital agency** 
 .
* Experience managing multiple projects and timelines.
* Strong communication, organization, and time\-management skills.
* Experience interacting with clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently and take complete ownership.
* Good understanding of creative, branding, and digital workflows.
* Ability to drive Designers, Writers, Developers, and other teams toward deadlines.
* Strong problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Good aesthetic sense and attention to detail.



 We Love When You Are
 



 🔥
 **A Fire\-Starter** 
 – You take initiative and solve problems early.
 



 🔄
 **A Multi\-Tasker** 
 – You can handle multiple projects without losing focus.
 



 📋
 **Organized** 
 – You bring structure and clarity to every project.
 



 🚤
 **A Team Driver** 
 – You keep teams aligned and moving forward.
 



 💬
 **A Great Communicator** 
 – You communicate clearly with clients and teams.
 



 🤝
 **A Relationship Builder** 
 – You build trust and maintain strong client relationships.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



 You're not just managing tasks and timelines.
 



 You're
 **creating clarity, driving teams, solving problems, and ensuring great work gets delivered on time.** 




 Success means:
 


* Projects delivered on time and within scope.
* Clear and proactive client communication.
* Efficient resource and team coordination.
* Minimal project delays and bottlenecks.
* Accurate project documentation and reporting.
* Improved team productivity and project processes.



 Apply Now
 



 If you're someone who enjoys bringing
 **people, ideas, and timelines together** 
 , we'd love to hear from you.
 



 Send your resume to:
 



 📩
 **people@springboarddigital.com**

title: SITE ENGINEER
description:
**Site Engineer – CIVIL/Pre\-Engineered Buildings (PEB) / Industrial Construction**
**Company:** 
 Infra Green Projects Pvt Ltd
   

  

**Location:** 
 Tiruppur / Tamil Nadu – Pan India Sites
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time \| On\-site \| Immediate Joining Preferred
   

  

**About Infra Green**
 Infra Green is a leading manufacturer and contractor for
 **Pre\-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB)** 
 and
 **Industrial Civil Construction** 
 , operating since 1997\. With state\-of\-the\-art fabrication facilities and end\-to\-end in\-house capabilities—from design and manufacturing to site erection and finishing—we deliver precision, quality, and on\-time completion for industries across South India.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The
 **Site Engineer** 
 will oversee end\-to\-end site execution for steel building erection, sheeting, and related civil interfaces.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in industrial construction or PEB projects, strong leadership in managing contractors, and strict adherence to quality, safety, and timeline standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan and coordinate site erection, bed\-bolt fixing, sheeting, and finishing/CIVIL CONSTRUCTION as per approved drawings.
* Conduct pre\-site inspections – verify location, coordinate with surveyor, and collect approval forms.
* Supervise bed\-bolt (B.B.) fixing, template alignment, and measurement verification.
* Prepare manpower, machinery, and material checklists (5 M Method – Man, Machine, Material, Method, Money).
* Manage contractor activities: obtain quotations, finalize time frames, and monitor progress against schedule.
* Ensure digital surveys, leveling, and alignment are done within tolerance limits.
* Oversee material dispatch, unloading, and storage compliance (minimum 4" above floor).
* Verify roof sheet and cladding installation, gutter fitting, RWP alignment, and flashings/louvers per design.
* Conduct daily toolbox and safety meetings; record attendance and site photos in ERP / WhatsApp group.
* Perform quality checks, maintain site checklist, and obtain customer feedback forms.
* Report deviations or design mismatches immediately to Project Head / MD.
* Submit final checklists, feedback, and contractor forms for payment release.


**Required Skills And Competencies**
* Strong understanding of CIVIL/PEB structure erection, sheet laying, and QA/QC standards.
* Knowledge of construction drawings, BOM, and survey equipment (Total Station / Auto Level).
* Proficiency in Prepare Estimations/ MS Office / Google Sheets / ERP entry for reporting.
* Good communication in Tamil and English; ability to coordinate with clients and workers.
* Hands\-on problem\-solving and site\-level decision\-making ability.
* Adherence to Infra Green’s safety, quality, and discipline policies.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* Diploma / B.E. in Civil or Mechanical Engineering.
* Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in PEB / Industrial Building Projects/CIVIL INDUSTRIAL PROECTS.
* Freshers with strong technical aptitude and willingness to travel may also apply.


**Benefits**
* Salary: ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 / month (negotiable based on experience)
* Site allowance \+ travel reimbursement \+ performance bonus
* Accommodation provided at site if required
* Rapid career growth opportunity in a fast\-expanding industrial infrastructure company

title: Project Engineer
description:

title: Planning Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 i3 InfraTech Private Limited is a civil engineering consultancy providing end\-to\-end services in Project Management Consultancy, Quantity Surveying, Bill Verification \& Certification, and QA/QC. Guided by the principles of Infinity, Innovation, and Integration, the company focuses on delivering projects on time, within budget, and to high quality standards. i3 InfraTech works closely with clients, consultants, and stakeholders to ensure transparent project control, accurate cost management, and rigorous quality monitoring throughout construction. From initial planning through execution, the firm emphasizes risk minimization, resource optimization, and value maximization. With a strong commitment to excellence and problem\-solving, i3 InfraTech positions itself as a trusted partner for smarter, efficient, and sustainable infrastructure solutions.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Planning Engineer role is a remote contract position responsible for supporting project planning and control across multiple civil engineering assignments. Day\-to\-day tasks include preparing and updating project schedules, coordinating with project teams to track progress, and identifying variances between planned and actual performance. The role involves analyzing resource requirements, production plans, and timelines to optimize project delivery, as well as contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies. The Planning Engineer will collaborate with project managers, quantity surveyors, and QA/QC teams to provide clear, data\-driven reports and ensure alignment with client expectations. The position requires proactive communication with stakeholders to maintain accurate documentation and support decision\-making.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Planning and Production Planning skills for developing, monitoring, and optimizing project schedules and resource utilization.
* Robust Analytical Skills to interpret project data, identify trends, and support risk assessment and performance improvement.
* Effective Communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and present clear reports to stakeholders.
* Experience in Project Control, including schedule tracking, progress reporting, and variance analysis.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Familiarity with project planning and scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or similar software).
* Understanding of construction processes, cost management, and QA/QC principles.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.
* Prior experience in consultancy or infrastructure projects is an advantage.

title: Quality Senior Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

**Job Description**
 The overall responsibility is to maintain the Quality Management System (ISO 9001:2015\) across the organization. Ensure the Production team is following the right quality to manufacture the products, adhering to the process requirements. You will also be responsible for New Product Development within the Factory and Local vendors. You will report to Quality Team Lead and follow a onsite working schedule in India Kancheepuram.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Maintain and Improve the Quality Management System according to ISO 9001:2015 standard and Internal CUBIC Procedures

* Non\-Conformity handling and engaging CFT team to perform RCA and Corrective Action for all Internal defects and Customer complaints

* New Product Development through Localization with New/existing Vendor that includes Vendor Evaluation, Sample Inspection, follow up with Global R\&D for critical parts form, fit and function approval, PPAP Documentation review and PSW sign off
* Managing Customer and Certification Audits
* Assist Manager in daily operations and ensuring the Production and Delivery plan is met


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* B.E or Diploma in Mechanical / Automobile
* The ability to travel 20\-30% of the time (within India)


**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
* 8 or more years of experience, including at least 5 years of relevant experience in Sheet Metal Fabrication.
* Experience in New Product Development and ISO Documentation.
* ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor and Six Sigma Certification will be added advantage.


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm

* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

 Others

title: Project Change & Configuration Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Project Configuration and Change Management (PCCM) Leader in Coimbatore we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in configuration and change management to a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, driven, and innovative teammates.
   

  

 You'll ensure accuracy, consistency, and traceability of delivered products and services to internal and external customers, keeping configurations under control and managing changes throughout the lifecycle of key projects, programs, or products. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (including procurement, industrial, tender/project management, and quality), lead Configuration and Change Management (CCM) activities, and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of defining the Configuration Management Plan (CMP) and leading Change Control Boards, but also monitoring CCM performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

 Leading CCM activities and deliverables for projects, programs, or products
   

  

 Defining and issuing Configuration Baseline Release Notes
   

  

 Ensuring consistency and integrity of baselines across projects
   

  

 Performing Configuration Audits and issuing Configuration Status Accounting Reports
   

  

 Coordinating and managing Change Requests end\-to\-end
   

  

 Monitoring CCM performance and implementing corrective actions
   

  

 Identifying and mitigating CCM\-related risks
   

  

 Providing feedback and contributing to the continuous improvement of CCM processes and tools
   

  

**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

 Degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Management, or a related field
   

  

 Experience in configuration and change management, with at least 8 years in a similar role
   

  

 Knowledge of railway products, solutions, and systems

title: QUALITY ENGINEER - EV Motor
description:
**Business Unit:** 
 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Quality Manager/Engineer \- Motor
   

  

 The Quality Manager/Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining world?class quality systems for
 **EV traction motors** 
 —covering stator, rotor, and motor assembly processes. The role ensures
 **IATF 16949** 
 compliance, drives
 **APQP/PPAP** 
 , leads
 **problem solving and customer quality** 
 , manages
 **SQE** 
 , and ensures all products meet safety, reliability, and performance standards. You will champion a culture of
 **zero?defect, customer obsession, and continuous improvement** 
 , while guiding cross?functional teams to deliver high first?pass yields, low PPM, robust validation, and stable production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Systems, Compliance \& Audits**
* Ensure full compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and customer?specific requirements.
* Lead internal and external audits (IATF, customer, regulatory) and close findings with sustainable actions.
* Maintain quality manuals, SOPs, Control Plans, PFMEA, inspection standards, traceability, and document control.


**NPI / APQP / PPAP Ownership**
* Lead APQP from concept → DV → PV → PPAP → SOP.
* Approve design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) plans including durability, thermal, dielectric, vibration/NVH, and EOL performance.
* Oversee PPAP submission: PSW, DFMEA/PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, Run@Rate, and capability (Cp/Cpk).
* Validate process readiness before SOP (tools, gages, measurement systems, automation, inspection plans).


**In?Process Quality \& Plant Performance**
* Own FPY, PPM, scrap, rework, and OEE?quality metrics for stator, rotor, and final assembly lines.
* Ensure robust Control Plan deployment, gage calibration, SPC on CTQs (hairpin welds, insulation integrity, press fits, magnet placement).
* Monitor and improve EOL test signatures: electrical performance, torque ripple, partial discharge, hipot, run?in vibration/noise.
* Lead Layered Process Audits (LPA), gemba walks, and containment for non?conformance issues.


**Supplier Quality Management (SQE)**
* Manage supplier quality for magnets, laminations, copper, machined parts, castings, adhesives/resins, sensors, and electronics.
* Conduct supplier audits (VDA 6\.3 preferred), approve PPAPs, ensure incoming quality checks, and track supplier PPM/OTD.
* Drive supplier corrective actions (8D), dual?sourcing risk plans, and cost?of?poor?quality reduction.


**Customer Quality \& Issue Resolution**
* Act as the primary interface for OEM/Tier?1 customers for all quality matters.
* Lead customer complaint resolution with 8D, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Manage warranty data, reliability growth, field returns (tear?down analysis), and customer scorecards.
* Own customer audits, QBRs, and new program readiness reviews.


**Problem Solving \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead structured problem\-solving (8D, A3, 5?Why, Fishbone) for line issues and customer complaints.
* Support Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen projects focused on yield, scrap, equipment uptime, and process capability.
* Enable digital quality dashboards, data analytics (FPY, PPM, Cp/Cpk, warranty), and predictive insights.


**Leadership \& Team Management**
* Lead a team of Quality Engineers, Technicians, Inspectors, and SQE.
* Define skill matrices, training needs, certification levels, and audit competencies.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.
* 2\-10 years of experience in electric motor design/manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership position within a Tier\-1 supplier/OEM.
* Hands\-on experience with motor manufacturing processes: lamination stamping/stacking, hairpin/conventional winding, insulation systems, laser welding etc.
* Familiarity with IATF 16949/ISO 9001 systems and production part approval
* Strong data analysis experience (Minitab, Power BI, SPC tools)
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision making under ambiguity


**L\&T Company Overview / About Us**
 L\&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi\-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top\-class quality have enabled L\&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
   

  

 Given L\&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well\-established capabilities in L\&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics \& Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design \& Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification \& Connectivity related products.

title: Project Quality Lead
description:

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Project Quality Lead in Coimbatore we’re looking for?

**All About You**

* Graduate degree in Engineering.
* 12\+ years of experience in quality management or related fields.

* Experience managing quality tools and problem\-solving methodologies.
* Proficiency in operational activities and documentation management.
* Strong team and people management skills, with the ability to positively influence cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Knowledge of quality standards (ISO9001, IRIS, CMMI, ECM, etc.) and lean principles.
* Process\-oriented and customer\-focused mindset.

**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that make a difference.
* Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.

 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

title: FHIR Integration Architect
description:
**About the Role** 

  
 





 We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full\-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design\-and\-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.
 

  
 




  





**What You'll Own** 

  
 




**Architecture \& Solution Design** 

  
 



* **Own** 

 the end\-to\-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event\-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12\) beyond the Cerner pilot.
* **Make** 

 build\-vs\-buy and vendor decisions (self\-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Design** 

 the architecture against HIPAA\-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least\-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre\-launch retrofit.
* **Validate** 

 the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR\-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.



  





**Technical Leadership \& Delivery** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 a cross\-functional engineering pod — full\-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.
* **Translate** 

 the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi\-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.
* **Own** 

 technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.



  





**Integration, Standards \& Compliance** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.
* **Define and enforce** 

 conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production\-ready.
* **Partner with** 

 compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit\-trail requirements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* 8\+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3\+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.
* Deep, hands\-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).
* Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.
* Hands\-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi\-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.
* Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event\-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.
* Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.



  





**Strongly Preferred** 

  
 



* Direct, hands\-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.
* Experience with Keycloak or another open\-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.
* Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR\-based prior authorization workflows.
* Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.
* Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near\-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already\-mature enterprise integration group.
* Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.



  





**Tech Stack You'll Work With** 

  
 




**Layer** 

  
 




**Technologies** 

  
 




**FHIR \& integration standards** 

  
 





 FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future\-facing) 
 




**FHIR server** 

  
 





 HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi\-tenant partitioning 
 




**Identity** 

  
 





 Keycloak, custom SMART\-launch extension (SPI) 
 




**Cloud / infra** 

  
 





 AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch 
 




**IaC / delivery** 

  
 





 Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker 
 




**Target EHR (Phase 1\)** 

  
 





 Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart\-toolbar launch) 
 




**Conformance testing** 

  
 





 ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 Design, configure, and deliver enterprise SAP Concur solutions by combining strong travel, expense, and invoice management domain expertise with AI assisted delivery and integration practices. title: Planning Manager - Civi
description:

 The Planning Manager – Civil is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Coimbatore, with flexibility. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company safety policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. The Site WHS Manger will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company safety policies.  Possess a thorough understanding of local/regional regulations and company policy.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Job Summary**
 Responsible for supervising and managing day\-to\-day production activities involving MIG/TIG welding, riveting, gluing, and torque tightening processes. Ensure production targets, quality standards, safety requirements, and delivery schedules are achieved through effective manpower management, process monitoring, and coordination with Quality, PPC, Maintenance, and other departments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise daily production activities related to MIG \& TIG welding, riveting, gluing and torque tightening processes.
* Plan manpower and allocate operators/workers according to production requirements.
* Ensure production targets are achieved as per daily/monthly production plans.
* Monitor welding parameters such as current, voltage, wire feed speed, gas flow and welding sequence.
* Ensure proper execution of MIG/TIG welding, including weld quality, appearance and dimensional requirements.
* Supervise riveting operations and ensure correct rivet type, size, positioning and fastening quality.
* Monitor gluing/adhesive application, including surface preparation, adhesive quantity, curing time and bonding quality.
* Ensure torque tightening is carried out according to specified torque values using calibrated torque tools.
* Verify first\-piece and in\-process quality and coordinate with the Quality Department for inspection and corrective actions.
* Identify welding defects such as porosity, undercut, lack of fusion, cracks, spatter and improper weld profile and take corrective action.
* Ensure proper use and maintenance of jigs, fixtures, welding machines, riveting tools, adhesive equipment and torque tools.
* Monitor machine/tool breakdowns and coordinate with Maintenance for quick resolution.
* Ensure operators follow SOP, Work Instructions, Control Plans and process parameters.
* Maintain production records, rejection/rework records, downtime reports and shift production reports.
* Control material wastage and improve productivity through 5S, Kaizen and continuous improvement activities.
* Train and evaluate operators on welding, riveting, gluing and torque\-tightening processes.
* Ensure proper PPE and safety practices are followed in the production area.
* Coordinate with PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Engineering departments for smooth production flow.
* Investigate production and quality issues and implement root\-cause and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper shift handover and communicate pending issues to the next shift.
* Maintain discipline, attendance and work allocation within the production team.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Diploma / ITI / BE in Mechanical, Production or related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in sheet\-metal fabrication/manufacturing production
* Strong practical knowledge of MIG \& TIG welding
* Experience in riveting, adhesive/gluing and torque tightening processes.
* Knowledge of welding defects and basic welding quality requirements.
* Ability to read engineering drawings, weld symbols and work instructions.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and basic inspection methods.
* Experience in manpower handling and achieving production targets.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and safety practices.
* Good communication, problem\-solving and team\-management skills.

title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate through a project’s life** 




  





 The company designs and manufactures process equipment used in food\-production environments. The Board needs an Independent Director who can govern the entire obligation created when an engineered system is sold—from interpretation of process requirements through fabrication, site integration, performance acceptance and long\-term service. Success cannot be measured only by dispatch: an apparently complete project can still carry unresolved hygiene, performance, documentation or margin exposure.
 



  





**Gate one: accepting the problem** 




  





 Before a bid becomes a contract, management must understand the customer’s product, process conditions, cleaning method, utilities, interfaces, throughput assumptions and acceptance criteria. The Director will challenge bid governance where requirements are incomplete, guarantees are broad or the proposed solution relies on untested assumptions. Commercial urgency should not bypass engineering review, capacity confirmation, site\-risk assessment or a clear allocation of interface responsibility.
 



  





 The Board should receive visibility into contractual exposure for delay, performance shortfall, contamination, consequential loss, intellectual property and changes in customer scope. Risk premiums and contingencies must be grounded in the actual project rather than applied mechanically.
 



  





**Gate two: freezing a cleanable design** 




  





 The appointee will seek assurance that hygienic design principles are built into equipment geometry, material choice, seals, welds, drainage, accessibility, instrumentation and cleaning validation. Design review should involve manufacturing, quality, service and commissioning, not remain isolated within engineering.
 



  





 Changes after design freeze need controlled technical and commercial assessment.
 



  





 Where digital controls or remote connections form part of the system, the Board must understand software ownership, access privileges, patching, data use and safe fallback. A cyber event that changes a process parameter can become a product\-safety event.
 



  





**Gate three: fabricating what was approved** 




  





 Material identity, surface condition, welding practice, outsourced treatment, calibration and inspection evidence all influence fitness for use. The Director will review how the company qualifies special processes, controls non\-conformance and preserves traceability. Schedule pressure must not move unfinished or conditionally accepted work downstream without named accountability and an agreed closure path.
 



  





 Management information should connect shop loading, material availability, engineering releases, rework and subcontractor performance. Reported project progress should represent earned completion, not expenditure or physical presence on the shop floor.
 



  





**Gate four: integrating at site** 




  





 Installation and commissioning often expose assumptions that were invisible during design. The Director will question site\-readiness checks, change control, safety planning, customer dependencies and escalation routes. Acceptance tests should be objective, witnessed and tied to the contracted duty. Punch lists must distinguish cosmetic completion from issues that prevent safe or hygienic operation.
 



  





 Revenue recognition, retention, warranty provision and project closure should reflect substantive acceptance and remaining obligations. The finance view and the project view must reconcile.
 



  





**Gate five: learning through service** 




  





 Warranty calls, spares demand, cleaning difficulties and repeat interventions contain product\-development intelligence. The appointee will encourage a closed loop from service into design standards, supplier decisions and commercial qualification. Aftermarket strategy should create genuine availability and performance value, not dependency through inaccessible information or restrictive practices.
 



  





**The enterprise decisions surrounding the gates** 




  





 The Director will participate in capacity, technology and market choices. They will evaluate whether modularisation, standard platforms, automation or strategic sourcing can improve delivery without concealing customer\-specific engineering. Working\-capital oversight will cover advances, milestone billing, long\-lead purchases, work in progress, claims and retentions. The Board will expect candid scenario analysis before expanding facilities or entering unfamiliar applications.
 



  





 Leadership review will include engineering authority, project\-management capability, quality independence, service responsiveness and succession for scarce technical roles. Safety, environmental performance and contractor governance will be treated as operating fundamentals.
 



  





**Experience and temperament** 




  





 The ideal candidate has senior responsibility in process equipment, food manufacturing, capital projects, industrial engineering, quality, operations, finance or project\-based business. Experience governing hygienic design, complex commissioning, contract risk or lifecycle service will be useful. The Board needs a person who can explore a technical issue deeply while preserving the distinction between oversight and execution.
 



  





 Candidates must be financially literate, conflict\-free and actively registered in the IICA Independent Directors Databank. Any relationship with customers, engineering consultants, component suppliers, contractors or competing equipment businesses must be declared.
 



  





**Candidate response** 




  





 Applications through India ID Exchange should include the Board profile, IICA confirmation and a brief explanation of how the candidate would determine whether a delayed project is suffering from execution weakness, defective commercial assumptions or both.

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

title: Java Module Lead
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

  

  





**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India**
  

  

  

 With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.
   

  

  

  

 The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.
   

  

  

  

 You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

  

  

 This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: GDS Cyber - DPP - Manager - AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SAP FSCM Senior
description:

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**Consulting \- FSCM Senior Consultant**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Consulting is a fast\-moving, high\-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
   

  

 In this role, we are looking for an experienced
 **SAP FSCM Senior Consultant** 
 to join our growing SAP Finance team. The FSCM consultant will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end implementation of SAP FSCM solutions. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in SAP S4 HANA FSCM, with minimum 7 years of hands\-on experience in FSCM end to end implementation
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct Business Blueprint design workshops to gather requirements and understand the client's business processes.
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA FSCM functionalities need enhancements or customization
* Handle complex enhancements in FSCM requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client's business requirements.
* Provide guidance and support to end\-users during testing, training, and post\-go\-live phases.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the senior manager.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow‑up on the action items from the workshops
* Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA FSCM Module.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills.


**What We Look For**
* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance/M. Com in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience between 3 to7 years
* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience in SAP FSCM Credit Management, Collection Management and Dispute Management, cash application\-High Rad Integration.
* Must have knowledge on 3rd party interface integration for credit management
* Should have knowledge on credit score calculation
* Should be aware S4HANA credit management functionalities
* Should have hands on experience to prepare functional specifications
* Should have knowledge in SAP FI Account Receivables
* Should be able to independently handle complex technical PO requirements.
* Should be good in Communication both written and verbal


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment** 
 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Project Manager (Modular Furniture)
description:
**Furniture Project Manager**




  





**Job summary**




  





 This job describes an integrated model covering planning, in\-house manufacturing and installation, and its case study specifically describes the project manager controlling installation against the approved floor plan, coordinating readiness, inspecting the completed installation with the client, and obtaining handover.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




1. **Sales\-to\-Project Handover** 
 \- Take over confirmed PO, BOQ, quotation, approved drawings, specifications, finishes, and client commitments. Ensure complete and accurate project handover from Sales.
2. **Scope Validation** 
 \- Cross\-check PO, quotation, BOQ, and drawings. Identify and resolve quantity, specification, and scope discrepancies before execution.
3. **Project Kick\-Off** 
 \- Conduct project kick\-off meetings with Sales, Design, Engineering, Purchase, Maintenance, Production, QC, Logistics, Accounts and Installation teams. Define responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables.
4. **Project Planning \& Scheduling** 
 \- Prepare the master project schedule based on the committed delivery and handover date. Track project milestones and overall progress.
5. **Site Survey \& Verification** 
 \- Coordinate site measurements and verify site conditions, access, lift, loading, flooring, electrical, and other requirements. Ensure site readiness before execution.
6. **Drawing Coordination \& Approval** 
 \- Coordinate preparation and approval of GFC/AFC drawings. Ensure approved drawings are available before production.
7. **Engineering Release** 
 \- Coordinate detailed production drawings, BOMs, hardware, and special requirements. Ensure accurate and timely release of production information.
8. **Change \& Variation Management** 
 \- Control all changes and revisions through proper documentation and approvals. Evaluate impact on project cost, timeline, and resources.
9. **Material Readiness** 
 \- Monitor project\-specific and long\-lead materials with Purchase and Planning teams. Ensure materials are available as per the project schedule.
10. **Production Planning** 
 \- Coordinate production priorities based on project requirements and installation sequence. Ensure furniture is manufactured as per approved drawings and timelines.
11. **Production Monitoring** 
 \- Monitor planned versus actual production progress. Follow up with Production teams and resolve delays or bottlenecks.
12. **Quality Management** 
 \- Ensure pre\-dispatch inspection of dimensions, finishes, hardware, quantity, and functionality. Ensure products meet approved specifications and quality standards.
13. **Client \& Stakeholder Coordination** 
 \- Act as the primary project contact for clients, architects, PMCs, consultants, and contractors. Conduct regular project review meetings and maintain MOMs.
14. **Site Readiness Management** 
 \- Verify civil, flooring, painting, electrical, access, and other site requirements before dispatch. Confirm site readiness for installation.
15. **Dispatch \& Logistics Planning** 
 \- Plan floor\-wise/zone\-wise dispatch and delivery schedules. Coordinate packing, labeling, transportation, unloading, and material sequencing.
16. **Installation Planning** 
 \- Plan installation manpower, supervisors, tools, equipment, and work sequence. Set daily and weekly installation targets.
17. **Site Execution \& Monitoring** 
 \- Monitor daily installation activities and progress against approved drawings and schedules. Ensure installation quality, productivity, and safety requirements are maintained.
18. **Issue Resolution \& Escalation** 
 \- Identify and resolve shortages, damages, drawing mismatches, site obstructions, and other project issues. Track issues with responsible persons and target closure dates.
19. **Snag Management** 
 \- Conduct joint inspections with the client/PMC and prepare snag lists. Coordinate with concerned teams for timely snag closure.
20. **Project Handover \-** 
 Coordinate final inspection and completion of all pending works. Prepare handover documentation and obtain client sign\-off/handover certificate.
21. **Commercial Closure** 
 \- Support billing by providing dispatch, installation, handover, and approved variation documents. Coordinate closure of project\-related commercial requirements.
22. **Project Closure \& Review** 
 \- Review actual project performance against planned cost, timeline, quality, and resources. Document rework, shortages, delays, lessons learned, and project closure actions.



  





**Qualifications:**




  




1. Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Interior Design, Furniture Technology, or related field.
2. 5–7 years of experience in furniture, interior, or fit\-out projects.
3. Good knowledge of furniture manufacturing and installation.
4. Experience in project planning, production, and site execution.
5. Ability to read AutoCAD drawings, BOQ, and project specifications.
6. Good knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, and ERP software.
7. Good communication and team coordination skills.
8. Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
9. Ability to handle clients, contractors, consultants, and internal teams.
10. Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

description:
**Scope**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Major Incident Manager (8–12 years) to lead and oversee the management of high\-severity incidents across complex IT environments. **Our Current Technical Environment**
* Incident management in multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure (on\-prem \+ cloud).
* Understanding of cloud\-native monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Operations Suite).
* Exposure to containerized platforms (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker).
* Familiarity with DevOps/SRE practices (CI/CD, automation, “observability as code”).
* Managing incidents in SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of cloud security, compliance, and governance impacts during incidents.


**What You’ll Do**
* Major Incident Leadership: Serve as the primary owner and decision\-maker for all high\-severity incidents, coordinating across multiple technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* End\-to\-End Incident Management: Manage the complete lifecycle of major incidents—from identification and logging to resolution and closure—ensuring adherence to SLAs and operational best practices.

* Proactive Risk Management: Collaborate with monitoring, infrastructure, and cloud teams to identify potential service\-impacting risks and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Reporting \& Metrics: Maintain dashboards, KPIs, and metrics to track incident trends, team performance, and continuous service improvement.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5– 8 years of experience in IT operations, service management, or incident management roles, with significant exposure to major incident handling.
* Deep understanding of ITIL processes, especially incident, problem, change, and service continuity management.
* Proven experience managing high\-impact, enterprise\-wide incidents in complex, multi\-cloud or hybrid IT environments.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and crisis coordination skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities under high\-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to drive cross\-functional teams during critical incidents.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, ticketing, and alerting tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Splunk, OpsGenie, SolarWinds).
* Preferred Skills:
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert certification.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and incident management dashboards.
* Experience in stakeholder reporting to C\-level executives.
* Exposure to compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements for IT operations.

description:
